links.outcome: Share of physician GenAI queries containing sensitive or personally identifiable information
links.effect: 2.68% (2866/106,942) of physician queries contained sensitive information, mostly from writing and editing; authors conclude privacy breach risk appears low.
links.quote: Fourth, only 2.68% (2866/106,942) of physician queries contained sensitive information, the majority of which were primarily derived from writing and editing.

screen.reason: Empirical observational study of real-world query-level usage of LLMs by nearly 1,000 physicians, characterizing workflow use cases and detecting privacy/PII risks, but not testing an organizational safeguard or deployment intervention.
